query: SELECT team_name, founded_year, ownership FROM team WHERE founded_year > 1967 OR team_name != 'Charlotte Hornets' OR team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' OR founded_year >= 1989;
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: founded_year > 1967 OR team_name <> 'Charlotte Hornets' OR team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' OR founded_year >= 1989
